fusions.name: Couched Lance
fusions.desc: A riding thrust that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 48%.

fusions.name: Hoofline Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the blade low through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Canter
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Blown
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 25 seconds.
